verdict.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration is a fair question for an agent platform like AnythingLLM, but the evidence pack never documents subagents, swarms, an agent-to-agent protocol, or parallel splitting of work. The only related items, "custom agent workflows" and an Agent Flows doc title, describe single-agent workflow configuration. That is an adjacent feature, not multi-agent collaboration, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work
